chunks: And when the Qur'an is recited to them do not bow in adoration?
ai.seo_question: Why do some people not prostrate when the Quran is recited to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific incident of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) reciting Surah Al-Insan or Al-Layl, where the disbelievers' refusal to prostrate signaled their hardened hearts and rejection of divine authority. This lack of *sujud* is interpreted not merely as a physical omission but as a spiritual blindness, contrasting with the believers who prostrate in humility, thereby highlighting the dichotomy between true faith and hypocritical indifference.
